<!-- gate-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the gate catalog and the checker's spec; edit those, not this block -->

Not in the default catalog: `init` does not seed it; a project declares it with `check:`.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Checker | `tests-retried` |

## How it measures

A suite with `retry_on_load:` runs once more a test that ran out of time while the machine was
loaded, and the run passes when the retry does (DESIGN-retry-on-load.md). The retry lets the
work go on. This informative gate keeps it from hiding a test that keeps running out of time:
over a test file, it lists the tests that passed only on a retry in the last 7 days, how many
times, and under what load the last time. A test that needed 3 retries reads as unstable.

## Declaring it

```yaml
gates:
  - name: tests-retried
    check: tests-retried
```

Source: [checker](https://github.com/co2-lab/anchors/blob/main/internal/gate/tests_retried.go) · [its spec](https://github.com/co2-lab/anchors/blob/main/internal/gate/tests_retried.spec.md)
